title: BDP Issue and Dependency Callables preview-1 structural projections
$comment: Feature-owned supplement to unchanged BDP v0.1. Shape validation does not establish support, authorization or implementation conformance.

issueUrl.description: Absolute canonical URL of an Issue Bead, as Core spells identities in records.

typeUri.description: Absolute identity URI of an Issue or Dependency Type from the Issue and Dependency Types package, or of a configured custom classification.

locator.description: A Scope-relative local path or absolute canonical URL naming one Issue Bead, resolved as Write resolves a mutation subject; never a fuzzy or prefix match.

instant.description: An RFC 3339 date-time with uppercase T and Z.

metadataValue.description: Any JSON value, including null; typed values persist as entered.

issueObservations.description: Operational observations about an Issue that change without minting a revision and therefore never appear inside the Bead record: the readiness projection and the claim lease.

heartbeat_at.description: The last heartbeat the lease holder sent.

is_blocked.description: The persisted, transitive readiness projection: true while an open blocking Dependency keeps the Issue out of the ready set.

lease_expires_at.description: Expiry of the current claim's lease, when one is active.

lease_granted_node.description: The replica that granted the lease; empty means unknown, treated as local.

issueView.description: An Issue as a callable returns it: the complete Bead record, the operational observations beside it, and the relationship cardinalities the native listings carry. The record is the one Core serves at the Issue's URL.

bead.description: The Issue's complete Bead record: identity, Type affiliation, revision, properties, metadata.

comment_count.description: Number of comments on the Issue.

comments_omitted.description: True when comment_count is nonzero and the view carries no comments.

dependency_count.description: Number of Issues this one depends on.

dependent_count.description: Number of Issues that depend on this one.

observations.description: Lease and readiness observations; an empty object when none apply.

parent.description: The parent Issue, computed from the parent-child Dependency, when there is one.

neighborView.description: An Issue on the far end of one Dependency, with the Link that leads to it.

issue.description: The neighbor.

link.description: The Dependency Link record whose Type says why the neighbor is related.

commentRecord.description: One comment on an Issue. Comments are not Beads in preview-1.

issue.description: The Issue the comment belongs to.

gateRef.description: One gate actively blocking an Issue.

reason.description: Why the gate blocks, in the provider's words.

type.description: The Dependency Type of the edge that reaches the gate.

issueDetails.description: The detail view behind the native show command: an issueView plus its neighbors, comments, gates and epic progress.

comments.description: The comment bodies; present only when include_comments was set.

dependencies.description: Issues this one depends on, each with its Link; reduced to identity fields when brief_deps was set.

dependents.description: Issues that depend on this one; present only when include_dependents was set.

epic_closeable.description: For an epic, whether every child is closed.

epic_closed_children.description: For an epic, its closed child count.

epic_total_children.description: For an epic, its child count.

gated_by.description: The gates actively blocking this Issue.

issue.description: The Issue itself.

unresolvable_dependencies.description: Outgoing edges whose far end has no record in this Scope.

unresolvable_dependents.description: Incoming edges whose far end has no record in this Scope; present only with include_dependents.

blockedIssueView.description: An Issue the native blocked listing names, with its blockers.

deduped.description: True on a stub recording only the edge into an Issue already expanded earlier in the answer.

depth.description: Distance from the root; the root is 0.

edge_from_parent.description: The Dependency Type of the edge that led here; absent on the root.

issue.description: The node.

parent.description: The node this one was reached from; absent on the root.

truncated.description: Always false in preview-1: a node beyond max_depth is absent, never flagged.

bondRef.description: A constituent of a compound molecule.

dependencyEdge.description: One directed Dependency as a request names it: source, target and Type.
